draft: In an alternative Mexico City shrouded in smog, towering skyscrapers cast long shadows across a bustling metropolis fraught with tension. Once vibrant murals now serve as silent reminders of past protests and lost dreams of unity. Social conflict permeates the city, with open operations of gangs and vigilante groups, symbolizing fragmented law enforcement. Capitalist hegemony tightens its grip on the populace through precarious gig work, overshadowing the once resilient spirit of mutual aid. As dusk falls, the lights of mega-corporate enclaves flicker to life over a landscape ravaged by inequality and unrest.
